patch_description:
Add a long-range CRZ entangler layer on diagonal qubit pairs before the final RZ post-processing layer. This introduces cross-layer entanglement via the four diagonal pairs (0,5), (1,6), (2,7), (3,4), sharing a single parameter `crz_diag` to maintain parameter economy. 

The rationale:
1. Current nearest-neighbor couplings (XX/YY/ZZ on adjacent pairs) may not capture correlations between distant qubits
2. Diagonal pairs create fundamentally new entanglement patterns that can improve separation on hard samples
3. Prior results show parameterized two-qubit coupling mixes improve worst-group margins
4. Single shared parameter keeps distinct parameter count at 11 (no efficiency penalty)
5. Placement before rz_post allows the final layer to exploit these new entanglement patterns

This targets the worst_group_margin_mean (currently 0.31) which dominates the robustness score.
